required.targetModuleKey: Destination registry module key for navigation
required.facility: Current facility mnemonic from hub filter

optional.returnRecordKey: Record to reselect when returning to hub
optional.hubScreen: Hub screen destination name for return links

hub_patterns.context_record_contract: contextRecord must already include facility, recordKey, targetEnvironment, sourceScreen, and searchText
hub_patterns.hub_screen_source: Set varHubScreenName from module-registry.json hub_app.hub_screen and map it once to hubScreenObject for Navigate()
hub_patterns.patch_nav_context: {targetModuleKey: ThisItem.module_key, launchUtc: Text(DateAdd(Now(), -TimeZoneOffset(Now()), TimeUnit.Minutes), "yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ"), targetScreen: ThisItem.target.landing_screen}
hub_patterns.on_select_screen: Set(varNavContext, Patch(contextRecord, patch_nav_context)); Navigate(ThisItem.target.screen, ScreenTransition.Fade, varNavContext)
hub_patterns.on_select_app: Set(varNavContext, Patch(contextRecord, patch_nav_context)); Set(varTargetAppId, LookUp(colModuleAppIds, key = ThisItem.target.app_id_env_var).appId); Launch(Concatenate('https://apps.powerapps.com/play/', varTargetAppId, '?tenantId=', varTenantId, '&source=moduleHub', '&targetModuleKey=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.targetModuleKey), '&moduleScreen=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.targetScreen), '&facility=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.facility), '&recordKey=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.recordKey), '&targetEnvironment=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.targetEnvironment), '&sourceScreen=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.sourceScreen), '&hubScreen=', EncodeUrl(varHubScreenName), '&searchText=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.searchText), '&launchUtc=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.launchUtc)))

module_patterns.app_on_start: Set(varNavContext, {targetModuleKey: Param('targetModuleKey'), targetScreen: Param('moduleScreen'), facility: Param('facility'), recordKey: Coalesce(Param('returnRecordKey'), Param('recordKey')), targetEnvironment: Param('targetEnvironment'), sourceScreen: Coalesce(Param('sourceScreen'), Param('hubScreen'), 'scrModuleHub'), hubScreen: Coalesce(Param('hubScreen'), 'scrModuleHub'), searchText: Param('searchText'), returnRecordKey: Param('returnRecordKey'), returnToast: Param('returnToast'), launchUtc: Param('launchUtc')});
module_patterns.return_to_hub: Navigate(hubScreenObject, ScreenTransition.None, varNavContext) for in-app modules; Set(varEffectiveReturnRecordKey, Coalesce(varCurrentRecordKey, varNavContext.returnRecordKey, varNavContext.recordKey)); Launch(Concatenate(hubAppUrl, '?tenantId=', varTenantId, '&hubScreen=', EncodeUrl(varHubScreenName), '&targetModuleKey=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.targetModuleKey), '&facility=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.facility), '&recordKey=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.recordKey), '&returnRecordKey=', EncodeUrl(varEffectiveReturnRecordKey), '&targetEnvironment=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.targetEnvironment), '&sourceScreen=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.sourceScreen), '&searchText=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.searchText), '&returnToast=', EncodeUrl(Coalesce(varNavContext.returnToast, 'Saved')), '&moduleScreen=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.targetScreen), '&launchUtc=', EncodeUrl(varNavContext.launchUtc))) for separate module apps
module_patterns.preserve_state: Persist varNavContext and reapply facility filter, selected record, and search text on hub re-entry

dataverse_rebind_checklist: Replace starter data sources with module-specific Dataverse tables
Map facility/source/target/action fields to real Dataverse columns
Update Patch() payload types to match Dataverse schema
Verify save/refresh/lineage display against the bound Dataverse table
